resources.string: Trail Together
Light the trail and get home before the fog!
Trail size
How long the trail is, how many colours it has and how fast the fog comes.
Little trail
A short trail with four colours: great for the youngest players.
Medium trail
Big trail
A long trail with six colours for practised players.
Helper glow
A soft glow on a good card. The Help me choose button always works, whatever you pick here.
Little trail only
The glow shows on the Little trail and stays off on the bigger ones.
Always
The glow shows on every trail.
No glow. Use Help me choose when you want a hint.
Turn the far hands around
Players sitting opposite each other read their own cards the right way up. Switch off for one person holding the device.
Helper pal level
Helper pals
Helper pals take their own turns, so a small team always has a full table.
Extra card for
Give one player a fourth card so different ages can play side by side.
Play on my own
You move two hedgehog pals home along the trail.
Play with helper pals
You and 1 to 3 friendly helper pals get everyone home together.
Two to four people play together on one screen. Helper pals can fill empty seats.
